event: The party enters the largest rest node yet, a sixty-meter cavern in the root network.
Its ceiling light cycles amber, blue-green and violet over four hours.
Dayo climbs to a braided-root high point by the east wall and sits still.
Vesper unfolds her Workframe and sets up the Field Forge.
Miriam tends Nadia's bruised shoulder, then counts the medical supplies.
Tomás circles the perimeter and comes back with a single nod.
Nadia names a jaw-shaped stalactite Gerald, the Ironjaw Sentinel's cousin.
Miriam objects; Gerald cannot be unnamed. Nobody laughs, but they hold it.
Two hours in, Dayo has not moved from the high point.
The party gives her space without agreeing to.
Nadia considers going to Dayo, then asks Vesper what needs cataloguing instead.
Vesper begins a six-hour forge session for the Floor 10 boss.
She cuts three Crystalback Plates along their grain to reflect force outward.
Over three hours she builds an arm guard with a Tower Crystal activation node.
The Sentinel Gambit: sixty seconds reflecting twenty percent of physical damage.
She had thought of it at two in the morning on the Floor 8 rest node.
Vesper builds three Null Compound grenades from Queen toxin and Emberstone Dust.
Each strips magic armor for eight seconds on impact.
The System flags Null Compound as an original formula by Vesper.
She makes six Anchor Vials for Miriam: 120 MP each, absorbed in ten seconds.
Vesper lays out the items and quietly explains what each one does.
Three hours into the rest, an inter-floor shop materializes at the north edge.
Solenne feels six Resonance Shards on its shelf, each a Harmony Aspect's frequency.
Solenne buys all six for 3,000 Tokens, leaving the party 200.
Nadia declares them technically destitute; Tomás corrects her; economically humble.
Solenne hands each person a warm shard.
Dayo comes down for hers, pockets it and climbs back up, her first move in four hours.
In the amber phase, Solenne briefs the Ironjaw Sentinel: Level 25, armored, three phases.
Phase 1 probes, Phase 2 charges, Phase 3 locks onto one target.
Solenne says Dayo is the counter to Phase 3, the only one who can survive it.
Without Last Stand, she says, the margin is thin: enough only if all goes right.
Solenne says they go in tomorrow; sleep if you can.
In the dark violet cycle the others sleep; Solenne cannot.
Dayo sleeps at ground level, gauntlets off; Vesper asleep at the forge.
Tomás is awake against the east wall, watching her; Solenne sits beside him.
Tomás tells her what he left out of his Floor 5 True Sight report.
He perceived text built into the wall structure, below the surface.
He cannot read it, but perceives the meaning: a list of six qualities.
The six Harmony Aspects, written into the Tower's original architecture.
The text predates the System, which was built on top of it.
Solenne asks why he didn't tell her before.
Three instances, Floors 5, 6 and 8: one is perception, three is fact.
Solenne writes the date and the word designed on a bare space of her staff.
They agree, unspoken, to keep it from the others until after the fight.
Morning: the cavern light returns to amber.
Vesper gives Dayo the Sentinel Gambit: left forearm, activated by a fist-clench.
The Null Compounds go two to Nadia and one to Solenne as backup.
The six Anchor Vials go to Miriam, who looks at Vesper and says nothing.
Nadia tries Gerald the Second, Gerald Junior; Miriam vetoes both.
Tomás says a Level 25 boss needs no name; Nadia says unnamed things are harder to kill.
Dayo comes down for the last time, the arm guard strapped on, and stands near Miriam.
Dayo asks Miriam to tell her when she is pushing range.
Miriam says she has been; Dayo wasn't listening.
Dayo says she is listening now: tell her again. Miriam says she will.
Six people with six warm shards walk toward Floor 10's entry.
